QuestInfo.name: [Communication] Client Privileges
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3001006##k from the merchant crew has something to say. You should get in touch with him.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you're pretty close with #p3001004# and #p3001005#, #p3001006# offers to tell you why they don't get along...for a price. Now's the time to use the #b#t4033389##k! You're an official client of the merchant crew.!
QuestInfo.2: According to #p3001006#, #p3001004# and #p3001005# used to be good friends. #p3001005# started falling behind #p3001004# in terms of trade record, and wanted nothing more than to drag him down too. It sounds a little like #rKaiser and Velderoth#k...
